proof.text: Construct the single-field GammaIdentityCondition witness. Its identity field is exactly the first component of SemilinearProperOpen.gamma_identities, specialized to quotientRings l E, quotientMaps l E, c.i and the identity square. The scoped proofsInPublic option on the proposition structure keeps the properness and site-size proof arguments in their original form, so the kernel checks the existing identity without unfolding the mate data.
